archetype: Agro-Terminal Command Center (Hybrid of Performance Pro & Jewel)
design_philosophy: A sophisticated, high-stakes trading terminal aesthetic grounded in earthy agricultural tones. Data density is high but clearly hierarchical. Micro-interactions provide immediate feedback.

headings.usage: Headers, large KPIs, module titles. Tight tracking.

body.usage: Data tables, standard text, UI labels, chat bubbles.

mono.usage: Ticker symbols, grain prices, volumes, logistical IDs, SLA times.

rules: No Inter or Roboto allowed anywhere.
Overlines/table headers must be Uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em], text_muted.

layout.sidebar: Fixed on the left, detached 16px from edges (floating style), rounded-xl, high contrast against app bg.
layout.dashboard_grid: Tight grid (gap-4 or gap-6). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12. Cards span intentionally to avoid jagged bottoms. Every pixel utilized.
layout.spacing_scale: Tailwind scale. Generous internal padding for cards (p-6) to prevent text collision with borders.

surfaces_and_micro_interactions.cards: Flat solid background (#121915), 1px crisp border (#1F2922), no ambient shadow. Subtle rounded-lg or rounded-xl.
surfaces_and_micro_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and border brightens to #2A3C30. Button text colors explicitly defined on hover.
surfaces_and_micro_interactions.tracing_beam: Use for high-value KPI cards or Active Contracts. A glowing gradient line that traces the border edge.
surfaces_and_micro_interactions.data_tables: Row hover gets bg-[#1F2922]/50. No vertical borders. Crisp horizontal 1px dividers.
surfaces_and_micro_interactions.glassmorphism: Avoid on this dashboard (as it's data-heavy). Use solid surfaces for optical clarity.

components.buttons: Shadcn based. Sharp or slightly rounded corners. High contrast text.
components.forms: Shadcn inputs. bg-transparent, border-subtle. focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary.
components.kanban: Horizontal scrollable flex container for Pipeline de Vendas. Column headers sticky. Task cards highly compact.
components.charts: Shadcn charts / Recharts. Dark theme ready. Grid lines muted to #1F2922. Use Accent colors for lines/bars (Yellow/Orange/Green).

modules.dashboard_executivo: Grid de KPIs focados em contratos, volume e faturamento. Alertas de mercado em painel dedicado.
modules.clientes: Tabelas avançadas para Produtores e Empresas com tags de classificação.
modules.pipeline: Kanban interativo, drag and drop, badges de histórico.
modules.contratos_e_pedidos: Formulários complexos estruturados em abas, com visão de status split-screen.
modules.logistica: Tabelas e mapas de pátio simplificados.

ia_agents.chat_interface: Floating or sliding right panel para Canal do Cliente. Distinct from main UI (lighter surface #161F1A) to signify conversational context.
ia_agents.message_bubbles: User: #1F2922 bg. AI: primary green border with transparent bg. Highlight key extracted entities (prices, names) in Yellow.
ia_agents.prospec_vendas: Widgets integrados no pipeline com sugestões highlight em laranja soja (#F97316).

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
testing_attributes.convention: kebab-case, role-based. e.g., data-testid='contract-save-button', data-testid='kpi-total-volume', data-testid='kanban-stage-negotiation'

media.instructions: Use these generated images for auth screens, empty states, or hero sections. NEVER use generic placeholders.
